subject: Your Friday night just hit 4PM
preview_text: The 30-second plan that saved 2,000+ Fridays. One tap. Tonight.
body_paragraphs: It's Friday. 4PM. You've got that blank stare at the ceiling—another night of 'what do you want to do?' and the couch wins again. Sound familiar? Couples who hit Tonight's Date before 5PM end up at a rooftop taco stand or a late-night bookstore, not scrolling Netflix.

Right now, the air feels like possibility. The weekend is a blank canvas. But planning fatigue kills it before it starts. That's why we built a 30-second escape hatch: one tap on a mood—cozy, adventurous, playful, healing—and the AI hands you a date so good your partner will think you've been reading their mind.

Open the app. See Tonight's Date at the top of your home screen. Tap your mood. That's it. No scrolling, no debating, no 'I don't knows'. Your partner gets a beautiful full-screen 'thought of you tonight' moment. And you get a night you'll actually remember.
Open SoulPlan: Plan Dates Together now. Tap your mood. See you at 7PM. P.S. The Memory Timeline will thank you tomorrow when you add that photo of the two of you laughing.
